author: Sarah Jenkins
tipText: Arrive around 4:15 PM to walk across the volcanic wave-cut terrace during low tide before sunset. Wear shoes with traction as the wet tide stones can be slick!

author: Liam O'Connor
tipText: The heated infinity pool looking out over the bamboo valley is incredible. Don't miss the complimentary daily afternoon Balinese tea and sweets at 3:00 PM!

author: Priya Sharma
tipText: Tuck away loose sunglasses and hats before the walkway as the temple monkeys are very curious! The sunset Kecak Fire Dance with the ocean roar below gave us goosebumps.

author: Lucas Vance
tipText: The 2:30 AM pickup was early, but standing above the cloud ocean while steam rises from the volcanic vents is unforgettable. Bring a windbreaker jacket as the summit gets breezy (14°C)!

author: Elena Rostova
tipText: Walk down past the upper tourist cafés to the lower stone subak irrigation pathways. The light filtering through the palm fronds at 8:00 AM is a photographer's dream.

author: David Chen
tipText: Take the cliff inclinator down to Rock Bar 40 minutes before sunset. Staying at the resort grants you priority queue entry to the best deck seating overlooking the waves!
